$comment: Single source of truth for the Windows MIDI Services SERVICE PLUGINS version.
This is a SEPARATE release train from the App SDK (build/version.json), and uses the
same scheme. build-plugins.ps1 stamps this into build/staging/version/BundleInfo.wxi,
the version include used by the oob-setup-* installers.
1.0.1-preview.1. Bump 'patch' for each release; that is what distinguishes builds.
build:         4th field of the numeric bundle/file version only. It does NOT appear in
the SemVer string. CI can override with -BuildNumber <n> without touching
this file; -BumpBuildNumber increments and persists it.
NOTE: patch starts at 16 because it now drives the MSI ProductVersion of both plugin
packages, and the previously shipped Basic Loopback MSI was 1.0.15.0 (Network was 1.0.0.0).
Windows Installer compares only major.minor.patch, so anything <= 1.0.15 would refuse to
upgrade an installed Basic Loopback package. The bundle SemVer 1.0.16-preview.1 also ranks
